title: Vietnam | World Coffee Guide
description: Vietnamese robusta is heavy and bittersweet, with dark chocolate and an earthy depth that stands up well to condensed milk. Vietnam is the world's second-largest coffee producer, and almost all of it is robusta from the Central Highlands. There is a much smaller amount of arabica too, mainly from Cầu Đất near Đà Lạt and from Sơn La in the north, which can be clean and tea-like.
seoDescription: Vietnam coffee guide: Đắk Lắk robusta, Cầu Đất arabica, cà phê sữa đá, USDA 2026/27 production.
